items.title: As Humans Write Less Code: Workloads Shift from Human to Agent Verification with Iterative Test Suites
items.excerpt: Analysts, analytics engineers, and even business users are writing less SQL and Python by hand. They prompt an agent instead, and with the right context (data models, docs, a data catalog), the agent writes a decent query. Think of a BI tool shifting left and democratizing new context from data models and sources. This helps the agents better understand the business problem and write a more accurate SQL query. With more advanced tooling that automatically reviews or generates queries iteratively, the agents’ output gets higher in quality every time. The models get better, and we can add additional documentation from internal Confluence pages or data catalogs, and it will get even better.
